assessments.reasoning: The exact dated W3C XPath 3.1 Recommendation and hash match the registration. Its map constructor section defines same key by op:same-key and states that duplicate entries raise the identified dynamic error. The atomization/type clause distinguishes failure to yield a single atomic key from the duplicate-key branch.

challenge.method: Follow the published same-key cross-reference. Compare identical literal keys, different numeric type NaN keys defined as equivalent, a key whose expression does not yield one atomic value, and separate map:merge duplicate handling.
challenge.results: The linked Functions and Operators 3.1 Recommendation treats float and double NaN as the same key and defines map:merge policies separately. Constructor duplicates under that equivalence lead to XQDY0137. A type-invalid key can fail before that comparison.

limitations: The dynamic error class need not indicate when an implementation first detects the error. The candidate does not govern merging maps or alternate errors.
